title: Tom's Pocket Money
text:
Tom is ten years old. He gets pocket money from his parents every Saturday. He gets five pounds each week. He likes to save his money in a small blue box.

On Saturday afternoon, Tom goes to the shop with his friend Sam. They buy sweets and a comic book. Tom spends three pounds and saves two pounds. He wants to buy a new bike next year.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Tom get each week?
Where does Tom go on Saturday afternoon?
What kind of person is Tom most likely to be?
options: A careful person who plans for the future
A person who never has any money
A person who gives all his money away

questions.text: What can we guess about the relationship between Tom and Sam?
options: They are good friends who like spending time together
They are a teacher and a student
They do not know each other
They are members of the same family

vocabulary.definition: to keep money for later instead of spending it
a place where you buy things
the part of the day between lunchtime and evening
a book with stories told in pictures and short text

paragraph_translations: Tom on yaşında. Her cumartesi ailesinden cep harçlığı alır. Her hafta beş pound alır. Parasını küçük mavi bir kutuda biriktirmeyi sever.
Cumartesi öğleden sonra Tom, arkadaşı Sam ile dükkâna gider. Şekerler ve bir çizgi roman alırlar. Tom üç pound harcar ve iki pound biriktirir. Gelecek yıl yeni bir bisiklet almak istiyor.
